title: Corporate Wellness Partnership: membership-balance goodwill waiver of the reinstatement fee
content:
Under the Corporate Wellness Partnership, a reinstatement fee otherwise equal to the tier's reinstatement fee amount is instead waived entirely, billed as $0.00, when the enrolled employee's own club membership account is not itself carrying a positive dues balance — a goodwill gesture for members who are otherwise current on their personal membership. Where the employee's own club membership account is carrying a positive dues balance, the fee after this check remains the tier's reinstatement fee amount, unreduced by this particular check.

Worked example (hypothetical): if an employee's own club membership account showed no balance owed, their enrollment's reinstatement fee would be waived entirely under this check, regardless of the tier's reinstatement fee amount. If that same membership account instead showed a positive balance owed, this check alone would not reduce the tier's reinstatement fee amount.
